title: Stored warp markers are checked, with their location in the manifest
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Stored warp markers are checked, with their location

  Scenario: Out of order
    Given a manifest whose markers[3] (warp, beat 6) is earlier in seconds than markers[2] (warp, beat 5)
    When I compile a score that uses the sample
    Then compiling fails with "steady-120.wav.apricity.json: annotations.markers[3]: warp marker at beat 6 (2.90 s) is before the one at beat 5 (3.00 s)"

  Scenario: Only one warp marker of yours
    Given a manifest with exactly one marker named "warp" with a beat
    When I compile a score that uses the sample
    Then compiling fails with a message naming annotations.markers and "needs at least two warp markers, or none"

  Scenario: A warp marker outside the audio
    Given a manifest with a warp marker at 99 s on a 9 s sample
    When the manifest is validated
    Then validation fails naming annotations.markers and the sample's length

  Scenario: A marker with a beat must be named warp
    Given a manifest with a marker named "cue" that has a beat
    When the manifest is validated
    Then validation fails with "annotations.markers[0]: only warp markers have a beat"
```
